id: title:bernatixer:switch batch trace summarization to gpt 5 nano on flex

review.posthog_relevance: Adds GPT-5-NANO and GPT-5-mini to the AI Gateway model allowlist and token budget configuration, and extends batch trace summarization tests to cover these new models and fallback behaviors.
review.reason: The change adds GPT-5-NANO and GPT-5-mini to the model allowlist and token budget configuration, establishing a baseline for billing and resource allocation. It also extends batch trace summarization tests to cover these new models and fallback behaviors. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the fallback and recovery behavior, the full OpenAI client setup, or the complete OpenAIModel.parse implementation. The tiered routing and recovery are described and partially implemented, but the complete behavior and its interaction with the gateway and the fallback path are not fully demonstrated.
